I am in the Somalie region where the rains are uncertain and my plot is small, so I will plant my saved local maize seed with some beans intercropped as I always do. I will put some manure from my animals on the field because we have livestock, but I will not use chemical fertilizer since it is hard to get here and too risky when the rain may fail. My family will do all the work ourselves as we always have, and we do not spray chemicals or irrigate because we cannot afford those things and there is no water source for the crops.
